```{r setup, include=FALSE}
payload <- params$payload
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r}
print_section_simple <- function(section_df) {
  if (is.null(section_df) || nrow(section_df) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(section_df))) {
    cat("### ", section_df$title[i], "\n\n", sep = "")

    display_place <- ifelse(
      !is.na(section_df$institution[i]) && section_df$institution[i] != "N/A",
      section_df$institution[i],
      section_df$loc[i]
    )

    cat(display_place, "\n\n")
    cat(section_df$timeline[i], "\n\n")

    bullets <- section_df$description_bullets[i]
    if (!is.na(bullets) && nzchar(bullets)) {
      cat(bullets, "\n\n")
    }

    cat("\n")
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(payload$intro)) {
  cat(payload$intro, "\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
print_section_simple(payload$sections$recent_professional_experience)
```

```{r}
print_section_simple(payload$sections$education)
```

```{r}
print_section_simple(payload$sections$academic_articles)
```
